article.headline: Roman Domon and Brayden Shorter lead Murray State to 70-53 victory over Wisconsin
article.description: — Roman Domon scored 26 points, Brayden Shorter buried six 3-pointers on the way to 18 points, and Murray State defeated Wisconsin 70-53 on Friday night in a consolation game at the Baha Mar Championship.
article.linkText: Roman Domon and Brayden Shorter lead Murray State to 70-53 victory over Wisconsin
article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — Roman Domon scored 26 points, Brayden Shorter buried six 3-pointers on the way to 18 points, and Murray State defeated Wisconsin 70-53 on Friday night in a consolation game at the Baha Mar Championship. Domon made only 7 of his 21 shot attempts but went 11 for 12 at the free-throw line. Shorter made 6 of 10 3-pointers. Jackson Ball scored 12 points for Wisconsin. Murray State shot 35% from the field in the first half and Wisconsin hit only 28%. The Racers had a 28-21 advantage on the boards. Domon scored 17 points, including a personal 7-2 run in the last 1 1/2 minutes, and the Racers led 38-22 at the break. Murray State's lead was down to 49-40 with 10 minutes left in the second half before Shorter hit 5 of 7 3-point tries in a five-minute stretch that pushed the lead to 67-43. The Racers (6-1) shot 38% for the game and were 11 for 30 (37%) from distance. Led by Domon, Murray State made 13 of 17 free throws. Wisconsin (4-2) shot 36% overall and made only 5 of 25 3s. Up next Murray State: The Racers host Washington State on Monday. Wisconsin: The Badgers host Northeastern on Wednesday. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here.
